operating_notes.text: Kanoria Africa Textiles contributed INR 108.5 Cr (7.25%) of total income last year.

APAG Elektronik AG (Switzerland) markets components manufactured by APAG Elektronik s.r.o. (Czech Republic) as part of **APAG Cosyst Group’s business model**, with transactions valued at **₹5,445 Cr (80%+ of APAG AG’s standalone turnover)**
Cosyst Control Systems GmbH incorporated two wholly-owned subsidiaries in Germany and Canada for automotive electronics development
FY25 consolidated revenue split: Electronic Automotive ₹782.40 Cr, Alco Chemicals ₹678.30 Cr, Textile ₹76.01 Cr.
Foreign subsidiaries APAG Holding AG and Kanoria Africa Textiles PLC had FY25 total revenue of ₹868.24 Cr and net loss after tax of ₹85.71 Cr before consolidation adjustments.
Standalone exceptional items of ₹44.99 Cr in FY25 were impairments of investments in Kanoria Africa Textile (₹20.25 Cr) and APAG Holding AG (₹24.74 Cr).
FY25 consolidated borrowings ₹594.12 Cr exceeded total equity of ₹510.36 Cr, with finance costs of ₹45.79 Cr.
Parent's loans to Kanoria Africa Textiles stood at ₹1,108.61 mn and to APAG Holding AG at ₹611.29 mn at 31 March 2025, with ₹42.52 mn of APAG interest overdue.
Ethiopian Birr devalued from 56 to 130 per USD during FY25; KAT revenue rose 21% in Birr but fell 31% in USD.
Ethiopia announced liberalisation measures in July 2024 relating to foreign currency, capital markets, and foreign bank collaboration
These liberalisations are ensuring better availability of foreign exchange and making the Company’s products viable in the export market
Expect improved performance and results in the near future
NCRPS are redeemable at par in five equal instalments at the end of years 8 to 12 from allotment, with board discretion to redeem any time after year 5.
Q1FY27 Chemicals segment revenue was ₹429.99 Cr, 93.4% of consolidated revenue.
Q1FY27 Textile segment revenue was ₹30.38 Cr, 6.6% of consolidated revenue, and turned profitable at ₹2.59 Cr.
NCRPS fair-value gain of ₹6.3 Cr included in other income; deferred tax liability of ₹1.56 Cr arose from the adjustment.
Launched a 12 TPD Triacetin manufacturing facility at the existing GIDC, Ankleshwar site, adding to the specialty chemicals portfolio.

predictions.kpi: Net debt reduction from NCRPS proceeds

timeline.summary: Kanoria Chemicals approved sale of 13.79% of Kanoria Africa Textiles to Hyperlabs Pte. Ltd. for USD 2 million, cutting its stake to 86.21%; completion expected by April 2025.
Kanoria Chemicals agreed to sell 13.79% of its stake in Kanoria Africa Textiles to Hyperlabs Pte. Ltd. for USD 2 million on 7th February 2025.
Q3FY25 revenue grew 1.6% YoY to ₹347.52 Cr but EBITDA turned negative at -₹0.44 Cr due to higher costs and exceptional item
Board approved re-appointment of Saumya Vardhan Kanoria as Whole Time Director for a 3-year term from 1st April 2025, subject to shareholder approval.
Care Ratings downgraded Kanoria Chemicals' long-term bank facilities to CARE BB+ Stable from CARE BBB and short-term to CARE A4+ from CARE A3+
Shareholders vote via postal ballot on director re-appointment and ₹544.5 Cr related-party transactions between APAG subsidiaries.

2025-04-16: Kanoria Chemicals incorporated two wholly-owned subsidiaries, Adapt Control Systems GmbH (Germany) and Adapt Control Systems Inc. (Canada), through its step-down subsidiary Cosyst Control Systems GmbH
2025-05-10: Postal ballot results passed director re-appointment and ₹5,445 Cr related-party transaction between APAG subsidiaries
2025-05-21: Board approved FY25 audited results with consolidated loss before tax of ₹97.25 Cr, recommended no dividend, and appointed MR & Associates as Secretarial Auditor.
Kanoria Chemicals approved divestment of its 100% stake in APAG Holding AG, Switzerland, with first tranche of USD 19.38 million infusion by subscribers leading to dilution from 55% to ~14.3%
Kanoria Chemicals initiated postal ballot process on 4 August 2025 to seek shareholder approval for divestment of 100% stake in APAG Holding AG.
On 2025-08-05, Kanoria Chemicals reported Q1FY26 results with revenue of ₹453.78 Cr (up 18.1% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹16.37 Cr (up 809.4% YoY).

Kanoria Chemicals' FY25 annual report showed consolidated loss widening to ₹108.15 Cr on ₹1,536.72 Cr revenue, with the auditor's CARO annexure flagging ₹42.52 mn of overdue interest on loans to APAG Holding AG.
Shareholders approved the divestment of 100% stake in APAG Holding AG via postal ballot on 3 September 2025.
Shareholders agreement entered into for divestment of APAG Holding AG on 15 September 2025.
Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Ltd held its 65th AGM on 26.09.2025 via video conferencing, with 32,078,586 equity shares participating.
FY25 results showed 4% revenue growth to ₹1,537 Cr but EBITDA fell 43% to ₹41 Cr due to segmental losses and forex impact.
Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Ltd’s 65th AGM on 26-09-2025 passed all resolutions, including re-appointing Smt. Madhuvanti Kanoria (DIN: 00142146) as Director.
Kanoria Chemicals reported Q2FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹91.81 Cr, driven by a ₹97.66 Cr gain on loss of control of APAG Holding AG, despite a 44% YoY decline in revenue.
On 28 January 2026, the Supreme Court dismissed the income tax appeal filed by CIT-IV Kolkata against Kanoria Chemicals (Civil Appeal No. 13772/2015).
On 28 January 2026, the Supreme Court dismissed the income tax appeal filed by CIT-IV Kolkata against Kanoria Chemicals (Civil Appeal No. 13772/2015).

Kanoria Chemicals reported Q3FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹3.55 Cr, a turnaround from a loss of ₹28.63 Cr in Q3FY25, driven by a gain on loss of control of APAG Holding AG despite a 23.5% YoY decline in revenue.
Q3FY26 results showed revenue of ₹193.29 Cr (up 20% YoY) and PAT of ₹1.94 Cr, marking a return to profitability after recent losses

On 12 February 2026, Kanoria Chemicals' board approved raising ₹50 Cr via 5,00,000 7% non-cumulative redeemable preference shares of ₹1,000 each to promoter group entity R. V. Investment and Dealers Limited, alongside an increase in authorised capital to ₹100 Cr.
Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Ltd held EGM on April 1, 2026, with 32,076,136 equity shares participating via video conferencing, chaired by Shri Rajya Vardhan Kanoria.

On 2 April 2026, Kanoria Chemicals disclosed EGM voting results: both special resolutions (increase in authorised share capital and ₹50 Cr NCRPS issue to promoter R. V. Investment and Dealers Limited) passed with 100.0000% of votes polled in favour and 0.0000% against.

On 13 April 2026, Kanoria Chemicals' board approved the Letter of Offer (PAS-4) for the ₹50 Cr NCRPS issue to promoter group entity R. V. Investment and Dealers Limited, which shareholders had approved at the EGM on 2 April 2026.

On 18 April 2026, Kanoria Chemicals allotted 4,95,000 7% NCRPS of ₹1,000 each to promoter group R. V. Investment and Dealers Limited for ₹49.5 Cr, completing the ₹50 Cr NCRPS issue approved at the 2 April 2026 EGM.
On 25 May 2026, Kanoria Chemicals reported Q4FY26 results with PAT of ₹31.62 Cr versus a loss of ₹40.11 Cr in Q4FY25, despite 29.4% YoY revenue decline

On 25 May 2026, Kanoria Chemicals reported FY26 results with PAT of ₹113.2 Cr, marking a turnaround from FY25 loss, and re-appointed Smt. Suhana Murshed as Independent Director subject to shareholder approval.
Kanoria Chemicals announced its 66th AGM will be held on 2 September 2026 via VC/OAVM.
FY26 annual report shows revenue growth to ₹981.43 Cr and PAT turnaround to ₹32.39 Cr with clean audit.
On 11 August 2026, Kanoria Chemicals reported Q1FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹26.36 Cr against a ₹13.78 Cr loss a year earlier, with revenue up 1.5% YoY to ₹460.37 Cr and EBITDA margin at 9.78%.
Kanoria Chemicals & Industries Ltd held its 66th AGM on 2026-09-02 via video conferencing with 96 members representing 32,078,694 equity shares attending.
On 3 September 2026, Kanoria Chemicals filed the Scrutinizer's Report for its 66th AGM held on 2 September 2026, confirming all four resolutions passed with over 99.99% of votes polled in favour.
On 7 October 2026, Kanoria Chemicals received credit ratings from Infomerics: long-term bank facilities IVR BBB-/Stable and short-term bank facilities IVR A3.

On 7 October 2026, Kanoria Chemicals launched a new 12 TPD Triacetin manufacturing facility at its existing GIDC, Ankleshwar site in Gujarat, targeting domestic and international food, pharma and industrial markets.
